mapper.select: SELECT l.LIB_NAME AS libraryName, c.CONFIG_CODE AS configCode, c.CONFIG_VALUE AS weekStart, DATE_FORMAT(c.SYS_MUSR_DTTM, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM LIBMSTR l LEFT JOIN SYSCFG c ON c.LIB_ID = l.LIB_ID AND c.CONFIG_CODE IN ('WEEK_START', 'weekStart') WHERE l.LIB_ID = #{libId} ORDER BY c.CONFIG_CODE = 'WEEK_START' DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CONFIG_VALUE FROM SYSCFG WHERE LIB_ID = #{libId} AND CONFIG_CODE = 'WEB_MENU_GROUPS_V1'
